require 'grpc'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'

module UploadService
  module V1
    class UploadRequest
      attr_accessor :filename, :content, :user_id, :checksum
    end

    class UploadResponse
      attr_accessor :token, :status, :path
    end
  end
end

class TokenGenerator
  ALPHABET = ('a'..'z').to_a + ('0'..'9').to_a
  TOKEN_LENGTH = 32

  def initialize(seed_source: :secure)
    @seed_source = seed_source
    @generation_count = 0
    @mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def generate_upload_token(user_id, filename)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @generation_count += 1
      raw_token = produce_token_bytes
      finalize_token(raw_token, user_id, filename)
    end
  end

  private

  def produce_token_bytes
    SecureRandom.random_bytes(32)
  end

  def finalize_token(raw_bytes, user_id, filename)
    # Incorporate request context into token for binding
    context = "#{user_id}:#{filename}:#{Time.now.to_i}"
    combined = Digest::SHA256.digest(raw_bytes + context.encode('UTF-8'))
    encode_token(combined)
  end

  def encode_token(bytes)
    bytes.unpack('C*').first(TOKEN_LENGTH).map { |b| ALPHABET[b % ALPHABET.length] }.join
  end
end

class UploadHandler
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/uploads'
  MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.txt .pdf .png .jpg .doc .docx].freeze

  def initialize
    @token_gen = TokenGenerator.new
    @rate_limiter = RateLimiter.new(max_per_minute: 30)
    @active_tokens = {}
    @token_mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def handle_upload(request, _call)
    validate_request!(request)
    @rate_limiter.check!(request.user_id)

    token = @token_gen.generate_upload_token(request.user_id, request.filename)
    safe_path = store_file(token, request.filename, request.content)

    @token_mutex.synchronize do
      @active_tokens[token] = {
        user_id: request.user_id,
        path: safe_path,
        created_at: Time.now
      }
    end

    response = UploadService::V1::UploadResponse.new
    response.token = token
    response.status = 'success'
    response.path = safe_path
    response
  end

  private

  def validate_request!(request)
    raise GRPC::InvalidArgument, 'Missing filename' if request.filename.nil? || request.filename.empty?
    raise GRPC::InvalidArgument, 'Missing content' if request.content.nil? || request.content.empty?
    raise GRPC::InvalidArgument, 'File too large' if request.content.bytesize > MAX_FILE_SIZE

    ext = File.extname(request.filename).downcase
    raise GRPC::InvalidArgument, 'Invalid extension' unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)

    basename = File.basename(request.filename)
    raise GRPC::InvalidArgument, 'Invalid filename' if basename.include?('..') || basename.include?('/')
  end

  def store_file(token, filename, content)
    safe_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
    dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, token[0..7])
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
    path = File.join(dir, "#{token}_#{safe_name}")
    File.write(path, content, mode: 'wb')
    path
  end

  def sanitize_filename(name)
    File.basename(name).gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
  end
end

class RateLimiter
  def initialize(max_per_minute:)
    @max = max_per_minute
    @requests = {}
    @mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def check!(user_id)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      now = Time.now
      @requests[user_id] ||= []
      @requests[user_id].reject! { |t| now - t > 60 }
      raise GRPC::ResourceExhausted, 'Rate limit exceeded' if @requests[user_id].length >= @max
      @requests[user_id] << now
    end
  end
end

class UploadServiceServer < GRPC::GenericService
  self.marshal_class_method = :encode
  self.unmarshal_class_method = :decode
  self.service_name = 'upload.v1.UploadService'

  def initialize
    @handler = UploadHandler.new
  end

  def upload(request, call)
    @handler.handle_upload(request, call)
  end
end

def main
  server = GRPC::RpcServer.new
  server.add_http2_port('0.0.0.0:50051', :this_port_is_insecure)
  server.handle(UploadServiceServer.new)
  server.run_till_terminated
end

main if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
